breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly replaces the uniform distributed load with its resultant point load (P = wL = 2500 N) applied at midspan, which is exactly the incorrect approach flagged in the inconsistency. The ground truth prompt omits this substitution entirely and expects the standard UDL cantilever formulas (δ = wL⁴/8EI, θ = wL³/6EI) to be used directly. The agent repeated the original error rather than correcting it.
